items.title: Spec-Driven Development with ATDD & AI (Valentina Jemuović)
items.location: Online
items.summary: You write a spec, hand it to AI, and it gives you back a PR that looks right. But the implementation can be wrong! In the current tools (Kiro, spec-kit, Tessl), the spec is a Markdown file AI is supposed to follow. But AI can ignore the spec or misread it. So you end up testing everything by hand, and QA keeps sending the PR back because it doesn't work. In this session, you'll see how to use ATDD to practice spec-driven development with executable specs. Starting from the acceptance criteria, AI writes failing acceptance tests (RED), and you review and approve them. Then AI implements the system code until the acceptance tests pass (GREEN), which shows that the acceptance criteria are met. …
